# A CAD book that buys US dollars four times at four rates and spends only
# Canadian dollars.
#
#     2026-02-01   1,000.00 USD at 1.20   1,200.00 CAD
#     2026-04-01   1,000.00 USD at 1.30   1,300.00 CAD
#     2026-06-01   1,000.00 USD at 1.40   1,400.00 CAD
#     2026-08-01   1,000.00 USD at 1.50   1,500.00 CAD
#                  4,000.00 USD           5,400.00 CAD of cost
#
# Four cost bases at four rates, none of them disposed of, so what the book
# holds is measured against all four added together — 5,400.00 for 4,000.00
# dollars, an average of exactly 1.35. Priced at 1.35 the gain is 0.00, and
# that zero is a figure the book has rather than an absence of one.
#
#     priced at    1.00      1.20      1.35     1.40     1.45     1.50
#     unrealized  -1,400.00  -600.00     0.00   200.00   400.00   600.00
#
# The rent is paid in Canadian dollars out of the Canadian bank, and none of it
# touches the US dollars. A Canadian account whose splits sit in US dollar
# transactions is what GnuCash's own reconstruction charged 19.86 to on the
# book Q-043 was reported from, so a figure that counted Canadian movements
# would show here.
#
#     10,000.00 opening, less 5,400.00 spent on dollars and 1,200.00 of rent,
#     leaves 3,400.00 in the Canadian bank.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 commodity USD
	mnemonic: "USD"
	fullname: "US Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: "Asset"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:CAD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:USD Bank
	type: "Bank"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Equity
	type: "Equity"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Equity:Opening CAD
	type: "Equity"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses
	type: "Expense"
	placeholder: #True
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Expenses:Rent
	type: "Expense"
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

	currency.mnemonic: "CAD"
	Assets:CAD Bank 10000.00 CAD
	Equity:Opening CAD -10000.00 CAD

		account.commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
		share_price: "6/5"
		value: "1200.00"
